description: Afgeleverd drinkwater naar herkomst; historie is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. Deze tabel beschrijft het afgeleverd drinkwater en de herkomst daarvan. Het CBS is gestopt met verzamelen en publiceren van deze gegevens. Het laatste jaar waarover gegevens beschikbaar zijn is 2003. Gegevens over recente jaren zijn beschikbaar bij de Vereniging van Waterbedrijven in Nederland (VEWIN): www.vewin.nl. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in Atom feed, JSON. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
